title: Advancing the understanding of PFAS-induced reproductive toxicity in key model species
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00145E, Critical Review
Open Access

Ran Tao, Mingliang Sun, Jiateng Ma, Jiali Li, Xinni Yao, Minjie Li, Liang-Hong Guo
This review summarizes PFAS reproductive toxicity in five model organisms, highlighting gonadal damage, hormone disruption, and transgenerational effects, to support model selection and future research strategies.
